senses.gloss:
भशिरा भशिरा, f. a sort of beet, Beta
Bengalensis.

भष् भष्, cl. 1. P. (in epic poetry also
A.) भषति (-ते), बभाष, भषि-
[]
तुम्, to bark, growl; to bark at, rail against, re-
proach, revile (with acc.).

भस् 1. भस्, cl. 3. P. बभस्ति (pl. बप्-
सति, Impv. 3rd du. बब्धाम्, Pāṇ. VI.
4, 100), भसितुम्, Ved. to chew, chew asunder; to
eat, eat up, devour, consume [cf. rt. 1. प्सा]; to crush;
(according to the Dhātu-pāṭha) to blame or abuse
[cf. rt. भर्त्स्]; to shine [cf. rts. 1. भा, भास्].
2. भस्, अस्, n., Ved. ashes.

भाष् 1. भाष् (connected with rt. 1.
भा as Gr. φη-μί with φαίνω), cl. 1. A.
भाषते (ep. also P. -ति), बभाषे, भाषितुम्,
to speak, talk, say; to speak to, address (with acc.
of the person or sometimes with acc. of the person
and thing); to tell or announce (anything) to (any
one); to speak of or about; to reply, to call or
name; to use or employ in speaking; to describe:
Pass. भाष्यते, to be spoken, to be addressed or
spoken to (sometimes with acc., e. g. स वचो मु-
निना बभाषे, he was addressed by the Muni in a
speech): Caus. भाषयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबभा-
षत् or अबीभषत्, to cause to speak or talk; to
say or speak; to cause disquietude, disturb (?): Desid.
बिभाषिषते: Intens. बाभाष्यते, बाभाष्टि.

भाष् 2. भाष् (fr. rt. भष्), Ved. occur-
ring only in the comp. रक्षो-भाष्, barking like
a Rākṣasa.

भास् 1. भास् (connected with rt. 1.
भा), cl. 1. A. (in epic poetry also P.)
भासते (-ति), बभासे, भासिष्यते, अभासिष्ट,
भासितुम्, to shine, to be bright; to appear; to
appear or come into the mind, to be conceived or
imagined, to become clear or evident: Caus. भास-
यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबभासत् and अबीभसत्, to
make shine, illuminate; to cause to appear, show,
make evident: Desid. बिभासिषते: Intens. बाभा-
स्यते, बाभास्ति; [cf. Hib. beosach, ‘bright, glitter-
ing,’ perhaps mais, ‘sparkling;’ probably Lat. fes-
tra, fas-tus.]

2. भास्, f. n. (according to some fr. rt. 1. भा,
q. v.; but according to Pāṇini III. 2, 177, fr. rt. 1.
भास्), light, glare, lustre, brightness; a ray or gleam
of light, (भासां निधिः, receptacle of rays of
light, the sun); an image, reflection, shadow; glory,
splendor, power, majesty; wish, desire.
—भासा-
केतु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. भासा inst. c. + केतु), Ved.
perceivable by light, appearing through light; (Sāy.
= ज्वाला-लक्षण-ज्ञापक.)
—भास्-कर, अस्, ई,
अम्, ‘light-causing,’ shining, glittering, bright, re-
splendent; (अस्), m. the sun, (if used at the end of
an adj. comp. the fem. will end in आ); N. of Śiva;
fire; a hero; the plant Calotropis Gigantea (=
अर्क); N. of various men; of a famous Hindū
astronomer, (also called Bhāskarācārya, q. v.; भास्-
कर is often found at the end of names, cf. ज्ञान-
भ्˚, ब्रह्मण्य-भ्˚, भगवद्-भ्˚, भगवन्त-
भ्˚, भाट्ट-भ्˚); (अम्), n. gold; N. of a Tīrtha.
—भास्कर-नृसिंह, अस्, m., N. of a Scholiast
of the last century.
—भास्कर-प्रिय, अस्, m.
‘fond of the sun,’ a ruby.
—भास्कर-भट्ट, अस्,
m., N. of an author.
—भास्कर-मिश्र, अस्, m.,
N. of an author; (also called भट्ट-भ्˚.)
—भास्-
कर-लवण, अम्, n. a particular mixture (contain-
ing salt &c.).
—भास्कर-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a
king of Kāma-rūpa; of a person mentioned in the
Daśa-kumāra-carita, p. 194, 1. 14.
—भास्कर-
व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a particular religious observ-
ance.
—भास्कर-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a com-
mentator of the seventeenth century; [cf. हरि-
भास्कर.]
—भास्कर-सप्तमी, f., N. of the
seventh day in the light half of the month Māgha.
—भास्कराचार्य (˚र-आच्˚), अस्, m., N. of an
author; N. of a celebrated astronomer and mathe-
matician who lived in the twelfth century and wrote
the Siddhānta-śiro-maṇi (which contains treatises on
algebra, arithmetic, and geometry, called Vīja-gaṇita
and Līlāvatī).
—भास्करि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr.
भास्-कर), the planet Saturn; N. of a Muni.
—भास्करीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or coming
from Bhāskara; (अस्), m. a pupil of Bhāskara.
—भास्करेष्टा (˚र-इष्˚), f. the plant Polanisia
Icosandra.
—भास्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing light,
luminous, splendid, shining; (आन्), m. the sun; light,
lustre, brightness; a hero; (अती), f. the city of the
sun; N. of a work; (according to Naighaṇṭuka 1. 8)
= उषस्, dawn; (यस्), f. pl. (according to Naighaṇ-
ṭuka 1. 13) = नदी, a river.
—भास्वती-करण,
अम्, n., N. of a work.

भष, अस्, ई, अम्, barking, yelping; chiding,
Ved.; (अस्), m. a dog; (ई), f. a bitch; (आ), f., N.
of a particular species of plant (= स्वर्ण-क्षीरी).

भाषा, f. speech, language [cf. देश-भ्˚, पर-
भ्˚, भूत-भ्˚]; common or vernacular speech (in
ancient times as opposed to Vedic, in later as opposed
to Sanskrit), any Prākṛt dialect, (the five Prākṛts
or vernaculars, viz. Mahā-rāṣṭrī, Śaurasenī, Māgadhī,
Prācyā, and Avantī, are called Pañca-vidhā Bhāṣā);
description, definition; (in law) an accusation, charge,
complaint, plaint; N. of Sarasvatī (goddess of speech);
of a Rāgiṇī.
—भाषा-ज्ञ, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भाषान्तर (˚षा-अन्˚), अम्, n. another dialect
or version, a translation.
—भाषा-परिच्छेद, अस्,
m. ‘definition of (the categories of) speech,’ N. of
a compendium of the Vaiśeṣika branch of the Nyāya
system of philosophy by Viśva-nātha.
—भाषा-
पाद, अम्, n. the plaint or charge, the first of the
four stages of a lawsuit.
—भाषा-मञ्जरी, f., N.
of an elementary work on Sanskrit grammar.
—भा-
षार्णव (˚षा-अर्˚), अस्, m., N. of a work by
Candra-śekhara.
—भाषा-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of a
commentary on Pāṇini's grammar.
—भाषावृत्त्य्-
अर्थ-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of a commentary on the
preceding work.
—भाषा-सम, अस्, m. a particular
figure in rhetoric, a sentence so arranged that it may
be either Sanskrit or Prākṛt.
—भाषा-समिति, इस्,
f. (with Jainas) one of the Samitis, moderation in
speech.
भाष भाष. See भास, col. 2.

भास, अस्, m. (sometimes written भाष), light,
lustre, brightness; shining, (at the end of a comp.,
e. g. चन्द्र-भास, shining as the moon); im-
pression made on the mind, fancy; a vulture; a
cock; a sort of bird described as a water-fowl; =
शकुन्त; = कुक्कुट; = नील-पक्षः पक्षी; a
cow-shed, cattle-fold (= गोष्ठ); N. of a Sāman
(also अम्, n.); of a man; of a dramatic poet; of a
son of a minister of king Candra-prabha; of a Dā-
nava; of a mountain; (ई), f. the mother of the Bhāsas
or vultures; N. of a daughter of Prādhā.
—भास-
कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
—भास-ता, f.
the being a vulture or bird of prey; vulturous nature,
rapacity.
—भास-विलास-संवाद, अस्, m., N. of
the twenty-fifth chapter of the Vāsisṭha-rāmāyaṇa,
commonly called Yoga-vāsiṣṭha.
—भासा-पुर,
अम्, n., N. of a town.
भषक, अस्, m. a barker, a dog.

भाषक, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking, talking about,
(at the end of a comp.)

भासक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to
appear, making evident, showing, manifesting; en-
lightening; making intelligible, (usually at the end of
comps.); (अस्), m., N. of a dramatic poet.
—भा-
सक-त्व, अम्, n. enlightenment, &c.

भषण, अस्, m. a barker, a dog; (अम्), n. the
act of barking, the barking of a dog.
1. भषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, barking, howling.

भषत् 2. भषत् (?), m. the heart; the
thigh; wood.
भाषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking, saying, talking.

भसद्, द्, m. the hinder parts [cf. भासद];
pudendum muliebre; mons Veneris; the sun; a
month; time [cf. भसन्त, भासन्त]; a sort of
duck; a float, raft.
भसद् भसद्, भसन, &c. See col. 2.

भसद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being or situated on the
hinder parts.
भसन, अस्, m. a bee; (also भसल ?.)
भासन, अम्, n. shining, glittering, illuminating.

भसन्त, अस्, m. time; [cf. भसद् and भ-
वन्त.]

भासन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, shining, splendid; beautiful,
handsome; (अस्), m. the sun; the moon; a star, an
asterism; the bird Bhāsa, q. v.; (ई), f. an asterism,
a Nakṣatra.

भसित, अस्, आ, अम्, reduced to ashes; (अम्), n.
ashes.

भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken, uttered, said; (अम्),
n. that which is spoken, speech, language, talk,
speaking.
—भाषित-पुंस्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. =
उक्त-पुंस्क, q. v.

भस्त्रका, f. a diminutive fr. भस्त्रा below;
[cf. भस्त्राका, भस्त्रिका.]

भस्त्राका, f. a diminutive fr. भस्त्रा above;
[cf. भस्त्रका.]

भस्त्रा, f. a bellows or a large hide with valves
and a clay nozzle so used; a leathern bottle or vessel
(used for carrying or holding water); a skin, pouch,
leathern bag [cf. मात्रा-भ्˚]; a particular manner
of recitation; [cf. भास्त्रायण.]
—भस्त्रा-फल,
f. a species of plant; (also written भस्त्र-फला.)
—भस्त्रा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with a bellows
or sack.
भस्त्रा भस्त्रा, भस्त्रिक, &c. See col. 2.

भस्त्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (according to Pāṇ. IV. 4,
16) = भस्त्रया हरति; (आ), f. (diminutive fr.
भस्त्रा), a little bag.
भस्त्री, f. = भस्त्रा above.

भस्त्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a bellows or
leathern bag.

भस्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, in भस्मकाग्नि = भस्-
माग्नि, q. v.; (अम्), n. a disease of the eyes (thick-
ening of the membrane with indistinctness of vision);
morbid appetite from over-digestion of food [cf.
भस्माग्नि]; gold or silver; a species of plant (=
विडङ्ग).

भस्मन्, आ, आ, अ, chewing, consuming, Ved.; (अ),
n. ‘what is crushed or consumed by fire,’ what is
reduced to ashes, ashes; [cf. भास्मन.]
—भस्म-
कार, अस्, m. ‘making ashes,’ i. e. using the ashes
of wood in place of soap or lye, a washerman.
—भस्म-कूट, अस्, m. a heap of ashes; N. of a
mountain in Kāma-rūpa; [cf. भस्माचल.]
—भस्-
म-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, see भस्मी-कृत.
—भस्म-
कौमुदी, f., N. of a work by Prāṇa-kṛṣṇa on
quicksilver and other metals.
—भस्म-गन्धा or
भस्म-गन्धिका or भस्म-गन्धिनी, f. ‘having
the smell of ashes,’ a kind of perfume (= रेणुका).
—भस्म-गर्भ, अम्, n. the tree Dalbergia
Ougeinensis, = तिनिश; (आ), f. a species of plant (=
कपिला); a kind of perfume (= रेणुका).
—भस्म-
गुण्ठन, अम्, n. the act of covering with ashes.
—भस्म-चय, अस्, m. a heap of ashes, an ash-heap.
—भस्म-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with ashes.
—भस्म-जाबाल, N. of an Upaniṣad.
—भस्म-
ता, f. the state or condition of ashes; (भस्मतां
या, to go to ashes, become ashes.)
—भस्म-तूल,
अम्, n. frost, snow; a shower of dust (= पांसु-
वर्ष); a number of villages.
—भस्मनि-हुत,
अस्, आ, अम्, ‘one who has sacrificed in ashes,’ i. e.
done a useless work.
—भस्म-पुञ्ज, अस्, m. a
heap of ashes, quantity or collection of ashes.
—भस्-
म-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘friend of ashes,’ an epithet of
[]
Śiva.
—भस्म-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become ashes,
changed into ashes, dead.
—भस्म-मेह, अस्, m.
a particular disease of the bladder, a sort of gravel.
—भस्म-राजी, f., Ved. a row of ashes, line or
stripe of ashes.
—भस्म-राशी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A.
-करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to turn into a heap of
ashes.
—भस्मराशी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or
changed into a heap of ashes.
—भस्म-रेणु, उस्,
m. the dust of ashes.
—भस्म-रोग, अस्, m. a
particular disease, a kind of bulimy; [cf. भस्-
माग्नि.]
—भस्म-रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, afflicted with
the disease called bulimy.
—भस्म-रोहा, f. ‘grow-
ing on ashes,’ a species of plant (= दग्धा, दग्-
ध-रुहा).
—भस्म-लेपन, अम्, n. the act of
smearing with ashes.
—भस्म-विधि, इस्, m. any
rite or ceremony performed with ashes.
—भस्म-
वेधक, अस्, m. camphor.
—भस्म-शय्या-श-
यान, अस्, m. ‘lying on a couch of ashes,’ an epithet
of Śiva.
—भस्म-शायिन्, ई, m. ‘lying on ashes,’
an epithet of Śiva.
—भस्म-शुद्धि-कर, अस्, m.
‘performing purification with ashes,’ an epithet of
Śiva.
—भस्म-सात्, ind. to the state of ashes, com-
pletely into ashes; (with rt. कृ or नी, to reduce to
ashes; with rt. गम् or या or अस् or भू, to go to
the state of ashes, become ashes, be reduced to ashes.)
—भस्म-स्नान, अम्, n. purification by ashes.
—भस्मा-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to reduce to ashes.
—भस्माख्य (˚म-
आख्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, called ashes, nothing but ashes.
—भस्माग्नि (˚म-अग्˚), इस्, m., N. of a disease
in which the food is over-digested or as it were
reduced to ashes, a kind of bulimy (?).
—भस्मा-
चल (˚म-अच्˚), अस्, m., N. of a mountain in
Kāma-rūpa; [cf. भस्म-कूट.]
—भस्मान्त
(˚म-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ending in ashes, finish-
ing with ashes (said of the body when burnt on the
funeral pyre); भस्मान्ते, Ved. in the neighbour-
hood of ashes.
—भस्मान्ति, ind. (= भस्म-स-
मीपे), near ashes, in the neighbourhood of ashes.
—भस्मापस् (˚म-आप्˚), f. pl. water with ashes.
—भस्मावृताङ्ग (˚म-आव्˚, ˚त-अङ्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, having the body covered with ashes.
—भस्-
माह्वय (˚म-आह्˚), अस्, m. camphor.
—भस्मी-
करण, अम्, n. the act of reducing to ashes; com-
pletely consuming or burning; calcining.
—भस्मी-
कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make
into ashes, reduce to ashes.
—भस्मी-कृत, अस्, आ,
अम्, reduced to ashes; calcined (as a metal).
—भस्-
मी-कृत्य, ind. having reduced to ashes.
—भस्मी-
भाव, अस्, m. the state or condition of becoming
ashes.
—भस्मी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्,
to become ashes.
—भस्मी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, be-
come ashes, reduced to ashes, being mere ashes,
being wholly worthless.
—भस्मोद्धूलित-विग्रह
(˚म-उद्˚), अस्, m. ‘whose body is strewed over
with ashes,’ an epithet of Śiva.
—भस्मोद्वपन
(˚म-उद्˚), अम्, n., Ved. the act of pouring or
shaking out ashes.
भस्मन् भस्मन्, &c. See col. 2.
भाषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking, saying, talking.

भाषिक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to common or
vernacular speech.
भाषिका, f. speech, language.

भाषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken to or
addressed.

भाषितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a speaker, talker; speak-
ing, talking, telling.

भाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking, talking, saying, tell-
ing, a speaker, (commonly at the end of a comp., cf.
अल्प-भ्˚, प्राकृत-भ्˚); loquacious, a chatterer.

भासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) shining,
brilliant (e. g. ऊर्ध्व-भ्˚, shining upwards; cf.
ज्योतिर्-भ्˚).
भासिन् भासिन्, भासुर, &c. See above.

भाष्य, अम्, n. speaking, talking; any work in
the common or vernacular speech; an explanatory
work, exposition, explanation, commentary in general
(but especially the explanation of technical Sūtras or
aphorisms); Patañjali's commentary on the Sūtras
of Pāṇini [cf. महा-भाष्य]; a sort of house or
building.
—भाष्य-कर or भाष्य-कार, अस्,
or भाष्य-कृत्, त्, m. ‘commentary-maker,’ the
writer of any explanatory work or commentary, a
commentator, scholiast, an expounder of technical
Sūtras or aphorisms; (especially) an epithet of Patañ-
jali, the author of the Mahā-bhāṣya or great com-
mentary on Pāṇini; epithet of the commentators
Nātha and Śaṅkarācārya.
—भाष्य-टीका, f., N.
of a commentary on the Mahā-bhāṣya; of another
commentary better known as Śrīmad-bhāṣya-ṭīkā.
—भाष्य-प्रदीप, अस्, m., N. of Kaiyaṭa's com-
mentary on the Mahā-bhāṣya.
—भाष्यप्रदीप-
विवरण, अम्, n., N. of Iśvarānanda's explanation
of the Bhāṣya-pradīpa.
—भाष्यप्रदीपोद्द्योत
(˚प-उद्˚), अस्, m., N. of Nāgojī-bhaṭṭa's expla-
nation of Kaiyaṭa's Bhāṣya-pradīpa.
—भाष्य-
रत्न-प्रभा, f., N. of a commentary on the
Śārīraka-mīmāṃsā-bhāṣya.

भास्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be made
visible, to be brought to light.
—भास्य-त्व, अम्,
n. the state or condition of appearing, visibleness.
—भास्य-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of a section in the
Kāktantra treating of the meaning of grammatical
forms.

भाष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being spoken to or
addressed.

भाषणीक्षौलेम भाषणीक्षौलेम, आस्, m.
pl., N. of a race (?).

भासमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, radiant; ap-
pearing.

भासयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making to shine, illu-
minating; shining, radiant (?).
भासस्, अस्, n., Ved. brightness, light, lustre.

भासाय, Nom. A. भासायते, &c., to act the
part of the bird Bhāsa, to appear like this bird.
भासु, उस्, m. the sun.

भासुर, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, splendid; terrible,
(in this sense probably an incorrect form); (अस्), m.
a crystal; a hero; (अम्), n. Costus Speciosus or
Arabicus; [cf. भास्वर.]
—भासुर-त्व, अम्, n.
splendor.
—भासुर-पुषपा, f. the plant Tragia
Involucrata (= वृश्चि-काली).

भासुरक, अस्, m., N. of a lion (in Pañca-tantra,
p. 53, 1. 17).

भास्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, radiant, brilliant,
bright, resplendent; (अस्), m. the sun; a day; N. of
a satellite of the god of the sun; of a Buddhist
deity; (अम्), n. Costus Arabicus or Speciosus (=
कुष्ठ; cf. प्र-भ्˚, भासुर).

भासद भासद, अस्, m., औ, m. du. (fr.
भसद्), Ved. (perhaps) the buttocks.
भास्कर भास्-कर. See under 2. भास्, col. 2.

भास्त्रायण भास्त्रायण, भास्त्रायणक (fr.
भस्त्रा), see Gaṇa Arīhaṇādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.

भास्मन भास्मन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भस्मन्),
made or consisting of ashes, ashy.

भास्मायन्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhas-
man; भास्मायनास्, m. pl., see Gaṇa Kuñjādi to
Pāṇ. IV. 1, 98.
